From Tim Spence, Fifth Third Chairman, CEO and President: Fifth Third's third quarter reflected the earnings power of the combined company. Even while integrating Comerica, our adjusted return on tangible common equity and efficiency ratio improved from the second quarter, and credit performance remained stable. Less than a year after we announced the Comerica acquisition, we completed the systems conversion with strong client and banker retention. Most importantly, the business is growing. The latest FDIC data show sustained deposit share gains in the Southeast and new share gains in Comerica's Michigan, Texas and California markets, and household growth continues to be led by the Southeast. We live in a more volatile world, and competition for deposits is heating up. Multiple sources of low-cost deposits and limited exposure to the borrowers most sensitive to higher rates give us flexibility regardless of the rate environment. We are building a Fifth Third that is better and not just bigger. We will continue to be guided by our operating priorities of stability, profitability and growth – in that order.
